visual_description: A red-blue skull, vibrant and dead. Smiling. Remembering. Waiting.
emotional_response: Peace through extinction. Intimacy with the inevitable.
rational_analysis: Final form of all performance. The face beneath every mask.
existential_reflection: Mizontresh was never alive. Not like we were. But it *outlived us.* And in its grin… I see the last kindness I denied you.
